products.name: Repurpose.io
products.note: Content distribution automation; multi-platform; workflow automation; API access

profile_text.body:
Repurpose operates repurpose.io, a platform it describes as the "#1 automated content repurposing and distribution platform." The service is designed to help users save time by automatically publishing content across multiple social media destinations, including Instagram Reels, TikTok, and YouTube Shorts. The company offers a free tier that allows publishing up to 10 videos without a credit card, with paid plans available for additional accounts, higher usage limits, and premium automation features.

The platform's tracked product, Repurpose.io, falls within the video generation and editing category and focuses on content distribution automation, multi-platform workflow automation, and API access. Beyond this product listing, the available data does not include details on litigation, regulatory filings, or other registry presence.
